title: Anglo-Egyptian War
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Anglo-Egyptian War", at revision 1379563388, opens: "The British conquest of Egypt, also known as the 2nd Anglo-Egyptian War, occurred in 1882 between mostly Egyptian and Sudanese forces under Ahmed ‘Urabi and the United Kingdom." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q616939, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1882 armed conflict in Egypt". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
